name: Commerce Bulk
description: Provides a service for bulk creation of Drupal Commerce entities.
project_description:
Provides a service for bulk creation of Drupal Commerce entities such as attribute values and variations . Also, products can be bulk generated if the Commerce Generate submodule is enabled.

 You may try all the above on the simplytest.me site. After installing the site go to admin/modules page, type generate in the textfield to find the Commerce Generate module, tick in the checkbox and then press the Install button. That's it, everything what you need for testing will be automatically installed along with the module.

 Dependencies 
 
 Drupal Commerce 8.x-2.x 
 Devel (optional, required only by the Commerce Generate submodule) 
 
 Commerce core feature request 

This module will be deprecated once [#2755529] is fixed and this functionality becomes part of Drupal Commerce!
